g.text: Break the chain: isolate untrusted-input tools from crown-jewel sources and egress, require
human approval between a sensitive read and any egress, or allow-list egress.
Add a human-in-the-loop gate on the high-impact tool, sandbox code/shell execution, or
prevent untrusted-input tools from sharing a context with high-impact tools.
Split the source and sink across trust boundaries, drop one capability, or require human
approval between reading sensitive data and any egress.
Require a confirm/approval gate before the tool acts.
Allow-list the specific hosts the agent must reach; deny all other egress.
Run exec/shell tools inside a sandbox (container/jail) and declare it.
Constrain the tool to an explicit allow-list of paths/hosts/resources it needs.
Set max_iterations, a budget, and a timeout.
